verdict.rationale: The EC/VC page says the team is "one of Europe's most active venture capital legal teams" offering "multi-jurisdictional support." It documents advising German bank N26 on a billion-dollar round with international investors (Third Point, Coatue, Dragoneer), backed by UK and German cap-table templates, European venture-debt work and offices across Europe and the US. missing for 10: any documented flip/redomiciliation work, detail on how multi-jurisdiction financings are structured or coordinated, and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own pages.
